remarks: Town and Country. Enjoy the best of both worlds in a sun-drenched custom built single family home one block from Greenwich Avenue and all of its shops, restaurants and amenities. Thoughtfully designed with generously scaled rooms throughout, this 4 bed, 5.1 bath 4,000+ sf home features an open floor plan on the main living level, exposures in every direction, a variety of spaces to gather, and elevator to all floors. The kitchen includes top of the line appliances, a butler's pantry, and eat-in breakfast area. Upstairs, the peaceful primary suite features a separate sitting area, large bathroom, walk-in closet, and french doors to a Juliet balcony. Additional outdoor spaces include a rear yard with stone terrace and fireplace, covered front porch, and third floor rooftop deck with outdoor kitchen and fireplace. Attached 2-car garage. Low maintenance, easy, and convenient to literally everything. In-town living and utmost comfort.
